response.rationale: Both translations and the sense are correct. However, Malaysian Malay also uses “sistem operasi,” while “sistem pengendalian” is the formal/preferred standard. Labeling the relation simply as “different-common-word” may misleadingly imply the terms are mutually distinct rather than shared synonyms with a register or preference contrast.
